name: Grupo Rolo
note: Industrial pastry and confectionery group (Pastelaria e Confeitaria Rolo, Novadolci, Hiperdolci, J&N Rolo), founded 1995, headquartered at Gaeiras, Óbidos. Its site describes it as a family business ('preservando a essência de empresa familiar') and says it launched the ROLO brand in October 2025. The owning family is not named on the site.
